units.source_text: 从这时候起，我觉得我对金阁的感情发生了微妙的变化。

en.t: From that time on, I felt that my feelings toward the Golden Pavilion had undergone a subtle change.

units.source_text: 虽然不能说是憎恨，但我有一种预感，

en.t: Although I could not call it hatred, I had a kind of premonition,

units.source_text: 自己心中渐渐萌生了一种与金阁决不相容的东西，无疑这种事态终究会发生的。

en.t: that something utterly incompatible with the Golden Pavilion was gradually taking root in my heart, and that this state of affairs would undoubtedly come about in the end.

units.source_text: 自从我游龟山公园之后，这种感情变得明显了。

en.t: After my visit to Kameyama Park, this feeling became clear.

units.source_text: 不过，我害怕给它起个名字。

en.t: Still, I was afraid to give it a name.

units.source_text: 然而，由于要值一宿的夜班，寺庙将金阁全委托给我，我高兴得喜形于色。

en.t: Yet when I had to stand night duty for an entire night and the temple entrusted the Golden Pavilion wholly to me, my delight showed plainly on my face.
